Junior college teachers protest proposed staffing norms in Latur

Junior college teachers in Latur, Maharashtra, staged a sit-in protest against the state's proposed staffing approval norms. The teachers are opposing the new regulations concerning staffing. The protest highlights concerns among educators regarding the implementation of these norms.
